row.body: A pack of supplies is hidden with the field bag; a note asks the next visitor to keep the watchers from seeing the unopened test kit.
row.title: Supplies kept out of sight

sidecar.gloss: A hidden supply pack includes an unopened kit and a warning about observers.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could have concealed equipment during an evacuation; the note does not say what the kit was for.
